entries.text: We are not to help ungodly and anti-Christ nations or show friendship towards them.

text.text: And Jehu the son of Hanani the seer went out to meet him, and said to king Jehoshaphat, Shouldest thou help the ungodly, and love them that hate the Lord? therefore is wrath upon thee from before the Lord.

entries.text: We can lend to other nations but are not to borrow from them.

text.text: For the Lord thy God blesseth thee, as he promised thee: and thou shalt lend unto many nations, but thou shalt not borrow; and thou shalt reign over many nations, but they shall not reign over thee.

The Lord shall open unto thee his good treasure, the heaven to give the rain unto thy land in his season, and to bless all the work of thine hand: and thou shalt lend unto many nations, and thou shalt not borrow.

entries.text: It is vain to rely on other nations for help while ignoring the aid of God.

text.text: Woe to them that go down to Egypt for help; and stay on horses, and trust in chariots, because they are many; and in horsemen, because they are very strong; but they look not unto the Holy One of Israel, neither seek the Lord!
Truly in vain is salvation hoped for from the hills, and from the multitude of mountains: truly in the Lord our God is the salvation of Israel.

caseRefs.name: Sodom and Gomorrah
caseRefs.charge: Grievous sin; inhospitality and violence against strangers

caseRefs.name: Rahab
caseRefs.charge: Receiving the spies with peace, and believing that the Lord had given Israel the land

caseRefs.name: The men of Succoth and Penuel
caseRefs.charge: Refusing bread to the Lord's army in pursuit, and taunting them with it

caseRefs.name: Barzillai the Gileadite
caseRefs.charge: Bringing beds, wheat, and honey to the king and his hungry men in the wilderness at Mahanaim

caseRefs.name: Hezekiah and the ambassadors of Babylon
caseRefs.charge: Showing all his treasures to Babylon in the pride of his heart

caseRefs.name: Ahaz
caseRefs.charge: Burning his children in the fire; copying the altar of Damascus; sacrificing to the gods that smote him

caseRefs.name: The centurion of Capernaum
caseRefs.charge: Loving the nation and building the synagogue; not counting himself worthy that the Lord should come under his roof: speak the word only
